notes: Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json), which wowsims models as one package for all three specs. That preset's Shadow Bolt was a stale rank (25307 cast at rank 9; the build's current top rank for 25307 is 10) -- fixed here. It kept Amplify Curse as a prepull (buffs the next curse) which Affliction alone talents into, so it stays; Demonic Sacrifice was dropped since sacrificing the pet is a Demonology-tree talent Affliction does not have. Immolate was dropped as a maintained DoT (Destruction's signature, not Affliction's) in favor of Bane of Agony and Corruption, and Wrack (1316697) is added as a third maintained DoT -- Forever's own tier 6 Affliction capstone, a 6 second instant DoT the base wowsims/classic Affliction tree does not have. Fix round 1 (superseded): Wrack was reported inert here because sim/warlock had no spell file for it yet. Rotation-accuracy program (2026-09-28): sim/warlock/wrack.go now registers Wrack for real (talent-gated on warlock.Talents.Wrack, RequiredLevel 40) -- the line below is no longer inert, and the level-60 ladder golden shows it as the spec's #2 damage source (behind Shadow Bolt), ticking at high uptime alongside the vulnerability aura the talent grants. The line's own note is corrected to match. Confirmed clean by the fix-round-1 review: Bane of Agony (11713) is exactly the spell id the engine's curse registration (sim/warlock/curses.go, function name getCurseOfAgonyBaseConfig notwithstanding) uses, and is fully castable; the separate 'Curse of Agony' spellconst entries (18671/1233077) are unrelated tuning data referenced nowhere in the engine, so no change was needed there. Rotation-accuracy audit, engine numbers (2026-09-28): Corruption's and Bane of Agony's per-tick base damage in sim/warlock (corruption.go, curses.go) carried classic tooltip values roughly double spellconst/warlock.json's own flat per-rank amount; fixed in the fork with a regression test each (commit 34803746d), which is why this spec's DPS dropped in this round's golden refresh -- the cast set and priority order are unchanged. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on it resolves and fires heavily (up to 62 percent of top casts) alongside Life Tap on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character. Rotation search (2026-10-06, level 60, 800 iterations, seed 7): Corruption now leads Bane of Agony, Wrack is recast in its last second instead of after it drops, Immolate joins as a fourth DoT ahead of Shadow Bolt, and the wand gate moved from 20 to 40 percent mana; about +5.6 percent in that run. Rotation search (2026-10-07, level 60, 800 iterations, seed 7): Bane of Doom (603) replaces Bane of Agony as the maintained curse after the engine took Doom's damage from the learnable client row (1742, coefficient 4.0): about +1.6 percent in this spec's run (a fight shorter than a minute would not pay Doom's single hit), beyond the combined error; Curse of the Elements measured lower than Agony.

engineering_notes.5: Wrack is live (sim/warlock/wrack.go, talent-gated, RequiredLevel 40). The level-60 ladder golden confirms high uptime and it as the spec's #2 damage source behind Shadow Bolt.

priorityList.notes: Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent, or a mana gem below 60 percent, saved for the closing burn if the fight is nearly over.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low; health is not a concern with three DoTs and Drain Life available.
Corruption is the cheapest DoT per damage and goes down first, then is kept up throughout.

Bane of Doom is the one curse kept up: it deals its whole damage when the minute is out, and recasting it as it fires beats the Bane of Agony it replaced once the client's own numbers (1742 at coefficient 4.0) are in the engine. Curse of the Elements and Bane of Agony both measured lower in the rotation search (2026-10-07 review).

Wrack (talent, learned at level 40) is an instant, no-cooldown 6 second DoT that also applies a 10% Shadow-damage-taken vulnerability to the target, so recast it in its last second to keep the vulnerability up without a gap.
Immolate is kept up as a fourth DoT: its damage over time is worth more than the Shadow Bolt it replaces for a global.
Shadow Bolt fills every remaining global while the DoTs run their course.
Shoot with your wand once mana is under 40 percent: it costs nothing, so mana regenerates while it keeps damage going. Life Tap is only the backstop below 10 percent.
